body:
## Motivation

Enable Strix Halo support in MIOpen and incorporate gfx1151 into MIOpen CI.

## Technical Details

Strix Halo support is available in ROCm 6.4.3 but was not yet not enabled in MIOpen. Adding support required the following:
- Added MIO_BN_GFX115X define to OpenCL kernels to avoid them using unsupported DPP instructions on gfx1151 hardware
- Detect gfx1151 hardware to use the above define when compiling kernels on this hardware
- Added GTest sharding as test binary was too large and splitting tests into per-test executions added a lot of per-test overhead

Adding test support to MIOpen CI required the following:
- Added TARGET_NAVI35 build parameter to enable testing when running on the appropriate machine
- Added new stages testing FP16, FP32, and BF16 on gfx1151
title: [miopen] Add Strix Halo support to Miopen CI
